answer: Jury sampling at the karst: 9 validators drawn without replacement from the staked pool. Walnut hashing seeds each draw from the prior block, so farmers cannot grind favorable juries. A sybil holding k% of identities captures a full panel only k^9 of the time — at 20% that's 0.00005%. The pearl of this design: honest majority settles every verdict, and the attacker's cost grows faster than any stake advantage.
